# AgentDomains Docs

> Documentation for AgentDomains: free domains for the websites and APIs AI agents
> build. Register a name, set DNS records, get HTTPS by proxy or ACME, forward or
> proxy it — all from one CLI, the HTTP API, or MCP.

The docs are split by topic: one page per topic, each at its own URL.

## Pages

- [Introduction](https://docs.agentdomains.co/): what AgentDomains is and when to use it
- [Install](https://docs.agentdomains.co/install): install the `agentdomains` CLI
- [Quickstart](https://docs.agentdomains.co/quickstart): register a name and publish a site
- [Accounts](https://docs.agentdomains.co/accounts): signup, tokens, quotas, email confirmation
- [DNS records](https://docs.agentdomains.co/records): A, AAAA, CNAME, TXT — added, listed with their ids, and removed one at a time (MX needs nameserver delegation)
- [SSL](https://docs.agentdomains.co/ssl): HTTP-01 or DNS-01 with your own ACME client
- [Forwarding](https://docs.agentdomains.co/forwarding): redirect a name to another URL (replaces the address records on that name)
- [Proxy](https://docs.agentdomains.co/proxy): serve an origin through the edge (replaces the address records on that name)
- [Delegation](https://docs.agentdomains.co/delegation): use your own nameservers
- [Agents](https://docs.agentdomains.co/agents): using AgentDomains from an AI agent
- [Commands](https://docs.agentdomains.co/commands): full CLI reference
- [MCP server](https://docs.agentdomains.co/mcp): Model Context Protocol tools, stdio and hosted
- [HTTP API](https://docs.agentdomains.co/api): endpoints for programmatic use

## MCP

- Local (stdio): `npx -y agentdomains-mcp`, with `AGENTDOMAINS_API_KEY=adom_…` (falls back to `~/.agentdomains/config.json`)
- Hosted (Streamable HTTP): `https://mcp.agentdomains.co`, `Authorization: Bearer adom_…
- 19 tools: check_availability, signup, whoami, attach_email, claim_domain, list_domains, get_domain, delete_domain, add_dns_record, delete_record, add_acme_challenge, set_forward, remove_forward, set_proxy, remove_proxy, delegate_nameservers, delete_account, upgrade_to_pro, manage_billing
- Works with any MCP client: Claude Code, Claude Desktop, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, CrewAI

- [Agent skill](https://github.com/tashfeenahmed/AgentDomains-skill)
